chapter_title_en: Storms Stir Beyond the Seas; The Thunder Strike
chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch.459 — Han Li’s Purgatory Thunder Erases a Ghost King
chapter_meta_description: Han Li gets ambushed by a hidden trap and nearly possessed by a ghost king—until a single golden lightning arc turns the tables completely.
og_title: Ghost King Down in One Hit — Purgatory Thunder Strikes
og_description: Han Li turns an ambush into an execution with Yang-aligned lightning, forcing the Profound Bone Saint to yield the Nine-Bend Spirit Ginseng.
twitter_title: That moment when a ghost king tries to possess Han Li…
twitter_description: Han Li gets ambushed by a hidden trap and nearly possessed, but one golden thunder arc turns the game around. Pure Mortal Stream counterplay.

lore_anchors.definition: Rare spirit insects that can devour almost any type of energy or material; Han Li’s primary swarm-based offense.
Black Yin-energy threads that freeze a target’s magic power and true essence on contact.
Yang-aligned golden lightning derived from Divine Thunder Bamboo; the absolute bane of Yin-type entities like ghosts and resentful spirits.
Legendary sentient spirit herb that can transform to escape capture; highly coveted by high-level cultivators.
A thousand-year-old undead cultivator existing as a Profound Soul Body; former master of Extreme Yin Island’s founder.
A high-ranking malevolent ghost entity; its formless dharma body is immune to physical attacks but vulnerable to Yang-aligned lightning.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did the ghost enter the formation without triggering it?
cultural_notes_faq.a: His formless dharma body could phase through certain restrictions by exploiting minute gaps in the barrier’s energy flow.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn’t Han Li notice the trap in the Golden Net earlier?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Soul-Threads were inactive until he fell out with the ghost king, making them impossible to detect during a normal inspection.
